property.name: subtitle
property.value: Switches, crumbles and two routes through the machines

property.name: text
property.value: The advanced chapter begins here. Read every mechanism before choosing the fast route.

property.name: text
property.value: First combination: bump the toggle, climb the solid colour, then run before the crumble floor gives way.

property.name: text
property.value: The lower clockwalk is safe. The upper gallery combines sun/moon stairs with moving seats.

property.name: text
property.value: Second combination: wait for the fountain to lift you, then slash the spined guard from the side before the gate.

property.name: text
property.value: The drum is the key to the balcony. Hold jump when you land on it.
